title: ForecastQualityParams
description: Parameters governing how organizational investment in research capacity reduces forecast noise. SPEC-BRIEF-2.

base_noise_scale.description: Noise half-width applied to each forecast field at investment=0 (worst quality).

quality_slope.description: Noise reduction per unit of investment: noise = max(min_noise_scale, base_noise_scale - quality_slope * investment).

min_noise_scale.description: Floor noise half-width reached at high investment (best achievable quality). The runtime loader (loadForecastQualityParams) enforces min_noise_scale <= base_noise_scale at startup.
